fusions.name: Follow the Throw
fusions.desc: Hurls a shaft at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. You rush up to 6 tiles toward it first.

fusions.name: Hail of Points
fusions.desc: Looses 3 spears at once, spread apart, each dealing 12 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Lunge Behind It
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 4 tiles forward.

fusions.name: Second Point
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a spear flies at the nearest enemy within 8 tiles that deals 8 damage. Once every 8 seconds.
